events.summary: Solid first cut grounded primarily in the UF/IFAS Featured Creatures publication (Hall 2019), the UF/IFAS Introduction to Florida Spiders, the LSU AgCenter orchard spider fact sheet, and spiderid.com/Missouri Dept. of Conservation for supplementary behavior and life-history. Confidence is high on range, identification, behavior, and size; moderate on seasonality timing in Florida specifically (most life-cycle data comes from temperate-range L. venusta studies) and on lifespan.
